display_name: 跨 RX 关系与增量响应：同包源身份梯度方向诊断
description: Four prespecified frozen first-seed students/ownEMA, legal L anchors180 and disjoint seen-L probes720. Measure exact default CE versus relation/response feature parameter gradients on the same packets, and signed branch evidence against correct identity. No fitting or training change.
authorization: Active user goal asks to explore effective feature-learning signals and the pasted relation/evidence proposal explicitly requires actual gradient and branch-signal diagnostics. All four source-frozen first-seed arms specified before target results; no target-dependent arm or parameter selection.

data.representation: raw received residual/post_sync/noeq IQ; fixed256 packet; deployed160-dimensional id_feat_joint
data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 capsule manifest; reuse unchanged
data.split_id: original registered source/target physical split; reuse unchanged
data.source_days_correction: Descriptive metadata corrected from [0,1,2] to actual native wisig_train_days/day_i [1,2,3]; same exact physical role IDs, no data or run change
data.leo_scope: User supplied current goal clean-only; no satellite training/evaluation in this new run

permissions.L_s: Legal source L6300:180 anchors+720 disjoint fixedseen probes. L TX only in diagnostic default CE, mass and true-margin measurements; relation/response objectives receive no labels.
permissions.U_s: No U IQ or truth access
permissions.V: No V forward/fit; cached source loader V immediately discarded
permissions.truth: No target scoring; legal L labels diagnostic only

checkpoint.initialization: All four fixedfinal50 students and their own EMA strictly loaded after exact parent proof. No optimizer/fit update.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Four source-only scratch33+17 final50 checkpoints; full source proof and strict student/ownEMA loading in preflight/audit.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Prespecified ZERO/ALL_REL/CROSS_REL/CROSS_RESP firstseed, no target ranking

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty;2 intraop/BLAS threads; healthy GPU jobs unchanged
execution.stop_rule: Only run-owned source/checkpoint mismatch, output collision, nonfinite values, exact default-head mismatch, parameter/buffer/gradient mutation or saved-source recount failure; no automatic retry, preserve all artifacts and unrelated tasks.

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Fixed source L diagnostic tensors only
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Source tensor roundtrip recount; no target scorer
metrics_plan.primary: Source local feature-gradient direction and signed identity response; no success/failure performance selection threshold

rows.purpose: Frozen same-packet source gradient/identity evidence measurement
rows.seed_notes: Same720 seen source L physical probes acrossall four models, disjoint180 anchors; two student views. Not2880 independent physical samples.

parent_config.training_recipe: historical batch_neighbor pseudo gate+EMA+cos; no satellite; allarms identical
parent_config.baseline_definition: user explicitly confirmed historical pseudo gate+EMA+cos, not CE-only baseline

feature_extractor.training_mechanism: source sample relations and additive CVS evidence response

parent_config.classifier: unchanged baseline ResidualPhysicalHead/6x160 cosine/scale30/branchLN/gain; no newhead/readout/calibration
parent_config.budget_authorization: user: feature extraction, historicaloldgate+EMA+cos; Agentchooseepochs normally<=50/model; fixedscratch50 33label+17pseudo allcontrols
parent_config.cost_claim: 4newfirstseed50, remaining8 only after frozen source criterion; complete12scratch50/133200updates plus3060Lanchorforward each; no headfit

relation.response_norm: SmoothL1 beta.02 sum anchor coordinates, mean RX/branches/packets
relation.feature: actual id_feat_joint joint160; auxiliary reconstructs exact values with detached PA/ref gains
relation.weakstrong: original EMA clean/native strong noise.015 and Dropout

config.diagnostic_labels: Legal L TX only in exact-default-head CE direction, same-TX mass and true-class margin measurements; never supplied to relation/response objective.
config.parameter_selection: All trainable id_backbone parameters excluding default class W and two fusion gains; actual same-packet CE versus R/E gradients
config.claim_scope: Frozen first-seed source L seen during training. Gradient dot products describe local steepest descent, not actual AdamW updates or unseen-RX performance. No method or weight selection from target results.

Joint partial gradients hold branch increments fixed; actual full feature parameter gradients are primary.
Dot>0 supports local steepest CE descent only, not an actual AdamW update prediction.
R/E losses, weights, source rules and live eight-row training remain unchanged.
